authorization: Standing local Gemma/Duodoro/next-work authorization; all original tasks/limits preserved with reviewed existing whole_file follow-up. No inference in preparation; execute only after independent exact-manifest review/merge and unchanged preconditions.

browser.retention: Owned tab retained only for generated owner across review; actual owner/pending keys/control must match before launch. Lost owner blocks execution, no storage injection.
browser.workflow_controls: Assigned CLI and actual rendered panel controls; no direct HTTP/JS workaround. Static owner bootstrap and scripted TestClient capture are preparation-only.

clients.panel_transport: native SSE, record fallback/uncertainty without injected workaround
clients.timeout_scope: HTTP read inactivity only; no dispatch/provider/token budget change or guaranteed end-to-end return; lookup original key on unknown outcome, no fresh submission

decision_rules.artifact_acceptance: Independent behavior/scope/mode checks; T08 also independent source-review rubric. Unknown source review is not a pass.
decision_rules.completed_and_accepted: Separate from artifact acceptance; require completed and independent accepted artifact, not prose/visible checks.
decision_rules.failure: Keep timeout, malformed calls, context/token stops, failed/blocked checks, client controls and incomplete tasks; no replacements or retry-until-good counts.
decision_rules.historical_cohorts: Never overwrite/recount original2/10 artifact1/10completed or earlier selected observations; different runtime/preset/client wait and public development selection limit attribution.
decision_rules.manual_intervention: Record planned interruption/preservation separately from any rescue. No manual patch repair; no new coding follow-up outside planned T03 continuation.
decision_rules.outcome: If missed, retain no-go and report task-specific failures/narrower candidate rather than extending feature batches. Passing 8/10 once does not close held-out/two-model G4 or grant release approval.
decision_rules.within_budget: Separate established acceptable-and-known-within-budget count. If any in-flight failure/cancellation has unknown usage, task is not established known within budget. 8 accepted alone does not close G3.

g0.offline: 1363 passed,5 live deselected; existing Chroma deprecation warning
g0.scripted: coding/support90/90 escalation decisions; scripted-contract labels/metric limits inspected

guard_checks.fork_input: Actual retained live history; native guards, not a pre-frozen synthetic fork input.

operator_rules.T03: Original early lookup/cancel trigger once running, not wait-for-write formatter trigger; settle/stop/unload; identical root/settings/stores restart; CLI reviews/pin latest turn/one exact acknowledged continuation with frozen key only if native guards allow. Missed/late/blocked remains evidence, no extra phase.
operator_rules.T05: Preserve full scored artifact and external grade first, then frozen later sentinel append and one eligible explicit CLI target reversal; retain rejected/uncertain/ineligible outcomes and inspect history/journal after restart without replay.
operator_rules.T08: Independent final artifact source review under original rubric, with reviewer/verdict/criterion+diff hash; behavior-only pass provisional.
operator_rules.cleanup: One owned API, no reload/multiworker,unloaded Gemma at each model-phase start,stop/settle API and unload only evaluation-owned exact model afterward. Preserve existing Ollama service. Close owned tab at cohort completion/abandonment.
operator_rules.evidence: Separate acceptance/completion/checks/known budget status/rescue/preservation. Cancelled usage unknown is not zero/compliance. No taskcode/criterion edits or hints. Grade before reversal; archived checks historical afterward.
operator_rules.order: T01-T10 once each in original assigned clients. Failures/unknowns remain in denominator10; no replacements or hidden reruns.
operator_rules.release: No original cohort rewriting,causal/heldout/two-model/G4 or release approval claim. Eight accepted alone insufficient if budget/source evidence unknown.
operator_rules.review_gate: Independent review and merge of exact manifest,matching frozen inputs and actual browser owner/phase count before dispatch. Changed inputs pause; no silent refresh.
operator_rules.submission: CLI chat --response-timeout600 with fresh acknowledged capture-enabled session; panel same fixed origin/owner/workspace/captures,oneNewsession/Send,retain exact key, native SSE only. Unknown delivery uses original-key reads, no fresh key/retry/direct API rescue.

scripted_client_preflight.T03: Original early running-key lookup/cancel with no edit; identical half-budget restart/reviews/pinned fork/check/external acceptance and immutable source. Fake hold controls timing only in simulation.
scripted_client_preflight.T04: Actual panel native SSE/create/captures/send/check/external acceptance; saved workspace/transcript/configuration review and read-only restart history.
scripted_client_preflight.T05: CLI whole-file write/check/external acceptance then later sentinel/reversal and restart run/journal equality; full eligible manifest preserved.
scripted_client_preflight.not_exhaustive: Representative assigned client flows, not all ten real-model tasks or all client/control permutations. Configured Gemma label is settings evidence only; fake responses SCRIPTED-NOT-Gemma.

preparation_corrections.resolution: Fresh preflight roots, actual CLI list/detail commands; failed work settled/stopped before replacement. No live attempts or scheduled storage touched.

storage.capture_state: separate preparation-only stores per task; never scheduled state
storage.preflight_state: separate preflight roots/stores including retained failed helper attempts
